idiotProofSteps: Boil 1.5 cups water in your electric kettle.
Add noodle cake and spice tastemaker sachet.
Let boil for 3 minutes until water reduces to a rich sauce glaze.
Drop in 1 tsp butter and top with cheese slice.
Cover kettle for 60 seconds to melt into a creamy noodle bowl!
jugaadHack: Eat straight from the kettle with a fork to leave zero dirty dishes.
substitutions: No cheese? A spoon of milk malai or mayo creates the same creamy texture.

idiotProofSteps: Crack 2 eggs in a mug with finely chopped onions, pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt 1/2 tsp butter in a hot pan; pour egg mix.
Immediately place 2 slices of bread right on top of the raw egg layer.
Flip after 90 seconds so the bread crisps up while egg cooks fully.
Fold the sides over the bread, toast for 30 seconds, and serve hot!
jugaadHack: Beat eggs with a fork in a coffee mug for 30 seconds for extra fluffy omelettes.
substitutions: No butter? Cooking oil or ghee works equally well.

idiotProofSteps: Tear 1 slice of bread into small pieces and press into the bottom of a coffee mug.
Spread 1 tsp ketchup over the bread base.
Layer with grated or sliced cheese and any diced onions or tomatoes.
Microwave on high for 60 to 75 seconds until cheese is melted and bubbling.
Sprinkle oregano or chili flakes and eat straight from the mug!
jugaadHack: Keep leftover pizza seasoning sachets in your study drawer for instant gourmet toppings.
substitutions: Use roti or biscuit crumbs if you are completely out of bread.

idiotProofSteps: Crush raw noodle cake inside the packet into small bite-sized pieces.
Transfer to a bowl or tiffin container.
Add the tastemaker spice sachet, chopped onion, tomato, and crunchy peanuts.
Squeeze 1/2 fresh lemon and shake sealed container vigorously for 10 seconds.
Eat immediately for an iconic, crunchy hostel midnight bite!
jugaadHack: Shake directly in the noodle packet or tiffin for zero dishwashing.
substitutions: Add bhujia or sev for extra street-style crunch.
